# TURN BY TURN DIRECTIONS [italic]From: your bunk, {colony}. To: the landing zone. Total time: about twenty minutes. Total distance: VectorQuest is not sure.[/italic]
## YOUR ROUTE - [bold]1.[/bold] Leave your bunk. Turn left. If your bunk has no door, the door is somewhere else. - [bold]2.[/bold] Continue down the corridor past the vending machine. Do not stop at the vending machine. - [bold]3.[/bold] Turn right at the notice board. The notice board says the meeting has been moved. Ignore it. It always says that. - [bold]4.[/bold] Go through the double doors. If the double doors are locked, find a Working Joe. If the Working Joe will not open the doors, it has a reason. Go round. - [bold]5.[/bold] Recalculating. - [bold]6.[/bold] Recalculating. - [bold]7.[/bold] Take the outdoor path toward the landing pad lights. Stay on the path. Things beside the path are not part of the route. - [bold]8.[/bold] Arrive at the landing zone. Your destination is on the left. If your destination is on fire, it is on the right.
## ROUTE WARNINGS - [color=#FFE066]Corridor closed by order of the administration.[/color] VectorQuest has routed you around it. VectorQuest has also routed you around the corridor next to it, out of curiosity. - [color=#FFE066]Heavy foot traffic near the garrison.[/color] Probably a drill.
## SHORTCUT AVAILABLE VectorQuest has found a route that is six minutes faster through the maintenance shafts. VectorQuest does not recommend it. VectorQuest did not find it. It was added to our database by a user with no name at 03:12.
